summary: Embotelladora Andina S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting an interim dividend declared by its Board on July 28, 2026, pursuant to authority granted at the April 16, 2026 shareholders' meeting. The dividend is Ch$51.0 per Series A share and Ch$56.1 per Series B share, payable August 27, 2026, from 2026 income. The shareholder registry closes five business days prior to payment. This represents a routine capital distribution rather than a special-situation event. No advisors or unusual mechanics are cited. Watch for subsequent interim dividends reflecting the company's ongoing payout policy.
